title: Same circle, new world
description: Citrus, vinyl and a wheel share one circular anchor and uninterrupted angular motion through a timed match cut.
useCase: Connect distinct subjects in a concise brand or product sequence.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion and keyboard activation change scene immediately. Keyboard activation also settles an interrupted pointer transition.
limitations: Three original SVG subjects and a finite scene transition; no video rendering, timeline editor or audio.
look: Flat illustrated orange slice centred on a warm cream background, with a small sans label, three dots and a circular outlined arrow button below.
motion: Pressing next spins the disc 360° over 680 ms (cubic ease-in-out) with blur peaking mid-turn, where the artwork and background cut to the next subject at top speed.
adapt: `next` runs a `requestAnimationFrame` `tick` (680 ms) that writes `rotate` and `blur` straight to `disc` and swaps `scene` at `t >= 0.5`. Replace `SCENES`, the three SVG subjects (keep a shared centre and outline) and the `data-scene` backgrounds.
